issue_context.title: 3D Animations doesn't play
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0 dev 2daef0400

### System information

Windows 10

### Issue description

The error happens on this line:
`quaternion.cpp:107 The start quaternion must be normalized.`




### Steps to reproduce

1. Import some 3d model with animation
1. Add to the scene
1. Open Animation Player in model node
1. Click "play selected animation from start" or "play selected animation from current pos"

### Minimal reproduction project

No need
comments:
this error is still reproduceable in: v4.0.dev.20210916.official [104a6191f]


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58845030/133887578-00bc1c01-fc5d-4a83-8fd2-8c0bd2bd9dbe.mp4

review_comments: Cause i don't want to make a refactor. I just fix the issue. Refactor should be different commit with commit message. (also unrelated to this issue)
I wonder if all the 12 constants should be replaced.
Maybe we should add something like this: `(sizeof(Quaternion) / sizeof(real_t)) + (sizeof(Vector3) / sizeof(real_t)) + (sizeof(Vector3) / sizeof(real_t)) + 2`
Are we replacing the 12 valued constants?

Yes. For the readability, we can replace.
Example:
`int transform3d_var_count = 12`
or
`int transform3d_var_count = (sizeof(Quaternion) / sizeof(real_t)) + (sizeof(Vector3) / sizeof(real_t)) + (sizeof(Vector3) / sizeof(real_t)) + 2`

But this is not related to this issue, we need to push another commit/pr
sizeof(Basis) is 9 floats vs sizeof(Quaternion) which is 4 floats.

@requizm This code is quite confusing actually because `transform3d_var_count` is not the variable count of `Transform3D`, it is the variable count of `TransformKey`'s members plus `Key`'s `transition` and `time`.
